summary: Reading index 36 completes the picture and reveals a hole rather than a value. Nodes 1, 2 and 5 report accepted 38 and decided 38, read index 36 as absent and hold the StopSign at index 37, while nodes 3 and 4 hold the StopSign at index 36, nothing at 37, and report accepted 37. The group counting 38 positions therefore cannot read one of them: there is a hole at index 36 with the StopSign pushed to 37, which is exactly the shape produced by sync_log adding one for a StopSign on top of a prefix that already covers it, inflating the accepted index without placing an entry. Node 4, the final leader, merged a StopSign-bearing promise at round 3 and holds a log ending with the StopSign at 36, yet reports decided 38 because handle_accepted takes the inflated group's reported accepted index once is_chosen counts a quorum, without comparing it to its own accepted index or requiring a matching local entry. Node 3 receives the Decides as its next expected messages, clamps at decided 37, sends no PrepareReq, is offered no AcceptStopSign because it already accepted one, and stays behind for the whole window. The update records the hole and inflated accepted index as a new fact, links it to the known sync_log arithmetic, revises the hypothesis accordingly, and restates the interpretation as a corrupt log layout plus an unsupported decided index rather than a simple marker placement difference. It also repeats that the earlier zero divergence count was an artifact of the comparison helper. No execution is requested.
